title: Keep isolated Windows HTTPS coverage selectors from silently shrinking
outcome: Keep GitHub Actions and the local Windows gate exercising every real HTTPS data-branch workflow test after test names change.
acceptance: A test name change cannot silently remove a real HTTPS data-branch workflow test from both isolated Windows test passes while other tests still pass.
The isolated Windows coverage continues to exclude the subprocess-only fixture entry point and fails when it selects no workflow tests.
